_comment: Single source of truth for the swap-hit glyph shapes. '#' = filled cell. Each mask has a 'color' (ARGB HUD tint) and a 'particleColor' (ARGB particle tint), and each carries 'vanilla' and 'practice' variants selected at runtime by the IndicatorType config. Particle sprites are baked OPAQUE WHITE by the bakeParticleSprites Gradle task (assets/.../textures/particle/<particle>.png) and tinted at render time by particleColor, so one static sprite serves both variants. Edit a mask here and BOTH the HUD glyph and the particle update.
